sources.name: PartyPlay originals
sources.description: Play solo or bring friends. A growing collection of local multiplayer games.

games.title: INKWAVE
games.description: A 4v4 ink shooter. Paint the most ground in Turf War, hold the zones, or team up against HULLBREAKER, a giant crab in a shipping container. A big room plays several arenas at once for the same two teams.
games.detail: Eight stages, twelve weapons and three modes: Turf War, Zone Control and co-op Boss Battle. One to 64 players join on their phones. An arena is 4v4: up to eight people share one, and a bigger room is dealt into as many arenas as it needs, all playing at once while the TV cuts between them and adds their scores up for the two room-wide teams (in Boss Battle, each squad of eight fights its own boss). Turn your phone sideways to get your own view, then move with your left thumb and aim and fire with your right. Pick a loadout and dress up your squidkid before each match. CPUs fill empty seats, except on Cargo Terminal, which is humans only.

games.title: Ichi
games.description: Match colors, hand out Gifts and shout Ichi! before anyone catches you on your last card. Big rooms split into tables.
games.detail: Match colors or symbols, stack penalties, bluff a +4, hand out Gift cards and race to call Ichi! on your last card. Up to ten share one table. Bigger rooms, up to 64, play at tables of four in six-minute rounds while the TV cuts between them.

games.title: Night Job
games.description: Three original 3D heists and eight specialists. One crew of up to four, or a whole room of rival crews racing for the fastest clean getaway.
games.detail: Choose from eight specialists across three original 3D heists. Up to four thieves play as one crew, with phones as touch controllers and the TV as the shared map. Five to 64 players split into rival crews of up to four: every crew robs its own copy of the building with the map on its own phones, while the TV cuts between the crews and keeps the board.

games.title: Kart Party
games.description: Five toybox courses, finishing on Rainbow Road, eight drivers and room for 64 racers. Drift for mini-turbos, grab items, and race friends or CPUs.
games.detail: Race solo against CPU drivers or bring the whole room: up to 64 people can race at once. Play on this screen with a keyboard, touch or gamepad, or use phones as controllers. Up to four racers share the TV in split screen; bigger groups race on their own phones while the TV shows a live broadcast.

games.title: Blockwild
games.description: Explore, craft and build your own world, or chase coins and cause mischief in Caper City.
games.detail: A blocky sandbox in three modes: survive and build in the wild, build freely in creative, or run gigs, borrow vehicles and dodge the Watch in Caper City.

games.title: Kitchen Rush
games.description: Cook orders and keep dinner moving, solo or together. Big groups split into rival kitchens.
games.detail: Chop, cook, plate and serve against the clock in eight hand-built kitchens with fires, conveyors, ice, drawbridges and portals. Up to ten chefs share one kitchen. Bigger groups, up to 64, become a restaurant of parallel kitchens that share the stars and race for Kitchen of the Night, with each phone showing its own kitchen.

games.title: Hijinks
games.description: A whole night of party games in one box: write, draw, bluff and vote your way to the most trophies.
games.detail: A whole night of party games in one box: write, draw, bluff and vote your way to the most trophies.

games.title: Trolley Court
games.description: Two teams stack the tracks with bystanders, culprits and twists, then plead with the Conductor. Someone pulls the lever. Fewest deaths wins. Big rooms fill the Gallery: pick a track to stand on.
games.detail: Two teams stack a split track with bystanders, culprits and twists, argue their case out loud and heckle from their phones, and the Conductor pulls the lever or does nothing. Up to ten players all argue. Bigger rooms, up to 64, seat three counsel a side each case while everyone else joins the Gallery: stand on the track you think will be spared, vote in a twist of your own and hop until the lever opens. Fewest deaths wins.

games.title: Island Settlers
games.description: Trade, build and sail a Catan-style island with private phone hands, plus Seafarers, Cities & Knights and more.
games.detail: A Catan-inspired game for 1–10 with Standard turns or Connect-style rounds. Mix in Seafarers, Cities & Knights, Explorers & Pirates, the Traders & Barbarians scenarios (Fishing, Rivers, Caravans, Barbarian Attack, Deliveries) and two variants. Play alone against CPUs on the host device, or invite friends with private phone hands. CPUs fill empty seats to the chosen table size. 7–10 player layouts and Connect are adaptations.

games.title: Sky Clash
games.description: A platform fighter above the clouds. Pick a fighter of the Reaches, rack up damage and launch your friends off the stage.
games.detail: Sky Clash’s own cast, the crew of the Reaches: Sola the lamplighter, Toll the bell-foundry automaton, Kes the kite-runner and Vesper the glasswright, each with an authored moveset, keyframed animation and four costumes. Fight on Beacon Rock and the Bellyard with CPU rivals, a shared display and landscape phone controllers. The earlier roster and stages remain selectable in a separate legacy group.

games.title: Starship Scramble
games.description: Captain your own starship in a co-op fleet of up to 64. Outrun the Armada, fight side by side in wings, and topple its flagship.
games.detail: Co-op starship command for the living room, for one captain or a room of 64. Each captain flies their own ship: target rooms, break shields with synchronized volleys, beam crew to allies, and race the Crimson Armada across one, three or five sectors, choosing your route at every exit. Five captains or more fly in wings of up to four that fight side by side while the TV shows the whole fleet. Play on landscape phones or solo on this screen. Save to continue later.

games.title: Phonedig
games.description: Dig for your pay, burst what guards it and bank the haul before the roof comes in. Up to four share a shaft; a bigger room splits into rival crews.
games.detail: You are paid for what you dig, not what you kill. One to four diggers share a shaft and a pool of lives: clear every monster on a level to bank the haul, and harpoon a fallen teammate back onto their feet. From five players up to sixty-four the room splits into crews of up to four, each in a shaft of its own, on a six-minute shift. The shared screen follows the action and the biggest share at the whistle takes it.
games.playTime: 6 min shifts · or dig until you drop

games.title: Hotpot
games.description: Draw ingredients, collect three sets, and outcook your friends. Bots fill empty seats.
games.detail: Draw ingredients, collect three sets, and outcook your friends. Bots fill empty seats.
